regimeSub: CPI day looms with 10Y at 5.24% as markets brace for acceleration above Aug 3.7% print.
themes: 10Y +2bp to 5.24% as pre-CPI positioning drives yields to fresh 24-year highs → 2s10s widens to +44bp; real rate (10Y-CPI) at 1.54% maintains restrictive financial conditions ahead of Oct 14 inflation release

CNBC Oct 13 warns 'inflation data expected to show price increases accelerating' → Sep CPI consensus risks upside surprise vs Aug 3.7%; Warsh Fed boxed between Sep NFP +29K weakness and sticky core PCE at 3.0%

South Korea President's 'unavoidable' rate hike comments trigger BOK independence crisis → KOSPI +2.3% to 6139 as won strengthens to 1337 from 1344; Governor apologizes over ETF risks per Korea JoongAng Daily Oct 12 while maintaining data-dependent stance

Brent +0.9% to $106.46 as Saudi output disruptions persist post-Iran interim deal → gold -0.8% to $4191 as pre-CPI dollar bid lifts DXY to 102.09; SPX flat at 7805 as equity risk premium compresses further against 5%+ yields
